The latest beta version of the WhatsApp Mac app lets users choose between daily and weekly update schedules, or manually check for updates. Details below.

WhatsApp is testing a custom update schedule for the Mac app

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is testing a new setting that lets users control how often the Mac app updates, choosing between getting the latest features as quickly as possible or opting for a more stable experience.

The site explains that WhatsApp has previously ended its TestFlight testing programme for Mac. Users who want to try new features now need to download the beta directly from WhatsApp, rather than through Apple's TestFlight platform.

According to WABetaInfo, the latest WhatsApp Mac beta (version 26.30.10.20) adds a "Keep up to date" section with two automatic update options:

  • Latest version: More frequent updates with bug fixes and stability improvements
  • Stable weekly version: Less frequent updates, also with bug fixes and stability improvements.

Screenshots from WABetaInfo:

As is typical when WhatsApp tests new features, the new functionality appears to be rolling out in stages, and not all users running the latest beta will have access to it right away.

WABetaInfo notes that WhatsApp has not officially announced the feature, nor revealed whether or when it might be rolled out more broadly.
